summary: Cosmo the Explorer is an interactive, AI-powered educational web platform developed to bring NASA's abandoned lunar and Martian spacecraft back to life for Gen Z, Gen Alpha, and Gen Beta students. Based on a field action research study of 49 students and a strategic SWOT analysis, our platform solves the challenge of rigid, text-heavy space content by transforming NASA open data into four engaging pillars: AI-narrated videos led by Cosmo the space cat, first-person interactive spacecraft stories, survival adventure games, and an integrated Ask Cosmo AI tutor grounded in official NASA datasets. Furthermore, the platform is critically important because it champions educational inclusivity; it features a dedicated accessibility corner with audio narration, visual translation, and a newly innovated Arabic tactile-audio code (Dhad Code, inspired by Morse code) to ensure students with special needs are never left behind in space exploration.
details:
What It Does & How It Works:

Cosmo the Explorer is a bilingual (Arabic/English) interactive web platform designed to make space exploration engaging and accessible for school students (Gen Z, Alpha, and Beta). Instead of passive reading, students explore NASA's abandoned equipment on the Moon, Mars, and deep space through four core modules:

1. AI-Generated Videos: Animated clips hosted by Cosmo the space cat, narrating probe missions in simplified language.

2. Interactive Storytelling: First-person illustrated narratives told from the perspective of the spacecraft itself.

3. Survival Adventure Game: Gamified missions where students solve real space challenges to help probes survive.

4. Ask Cosmo AI Tutor: A generative AI assistant strictly grounded in official NASA datasets, offering instant age-appropriate answers and one-click curiosity prompts.

Creativity & Inclusivity Innovation:

Our primary breakthrough is democratizing space science for students with special needs. Alongside audio narration and visual translation, we innovated the "Dhad Code"—an original Arabic audio-tactile communication system inspired by Morse code—enabling visually and hearing-impaired students to independently explore space data. Additionally, we localized space concepts by connecting the Martian terrain to the desert sands of Bidiyah, Oman, accompanied by our original bilingual theme song, "Beyond the Orbit."

Development Tools & Methodology:

نقطة تعداد Field Research & Strategy: Built upon an Action Research survey of 49 students (showing 83.6% lacked detailed knowledge of abandoned NASA hardware and 77.6% demanded accessibility tools) and a strategic SWOT analysis.

نقطة تعداد Tech Stack & AI Tools: Developed using modern web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript), Gemini AI and ChatGPT (for interactive AI tutoring and code structuring), Manus and Google Flow (for AI video and media generation), and Canva (for visual storytelling and UI assets).

Expected Impact:

Cosmo the Explorer transforms traditional science lessons into an inclusive, interactive experience ready for immediate adoption across schools in Oman and the Arab world, ensuring that space truly belongs to everyone.
